text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Overview

The Orbitra RoboVac R7 is a robot vacuum cleaner with a mopping module and LiDAR navigation.
It builds a map of your home, cleans room by room and returns to its charging dock automatically.
The robot is controlled with the buttons on its top cover or with the Orbitra Home mobile app.
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Technical specifications

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Navigation | LiDAR laser distance sensor + 3D obstacle sensor |
| Maximum suction power | 4000 Pa |
| Battery | 5200 mAh Li-ion |
| Runtime | up to 150 min (Eco), 110 min (Standard), 70 min (Max) |
| Charging time | about 4.5 hours from empty to full |
| Dustbin capacity | 450 ml |
| Water tank capacity | 300 ml |
| Maximum climbing height | 20 mm (door thresholds, rug edges) |
| Noise level | 58 dB (Standard mode) |
| Wi-Fi | 2.4 GHz only (802.11 b/g/n); 5 GHz networks are not supported |
| Saved maps | up to 4 floor maps |
| Operating temperature | 0 °C to 40 °C |
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: What is in the box

Robot, charging dock with power cable, mopping module with one washable mop pad, one spare
side brush, cleaning tool (with brush cutter blade), quick start guide.
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Installation of the charging dock

1. Place the dock on a hard, level floor against a wall.
2. Keep at least 0.5 m of free space on both sides of the dock and 1.5 m in front of it.
3. Do not place the dock in direct sunlight or near stairs.
4. Plug in the power cable. The dock indicator lights up white.
5. Place the robot on the dock manually before the first use and let it charge fully (about 4.5 hours).
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Connecting to the Orbitra Home app

1. Install the Orbitra Home app and create an account.
2. Make sure your phone is connected to a **2.4 GHz** Wi-Fi network.
3. Press and hold the **Power** and **Home** buttons together for **5 seconds** until you hear
   "Wi-Fi reset" and the light ring blinks blue.
4. In the app tap **Add device › RoboVac R7** and follow the instructions.

If pairing fails, see the section *Wi-Fi connection problems*.
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
section: Connecting to the Orbitra Home app

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Cleaning modes

* **Auto clean** — cleans the whole map room by room.
* **Room clean** — cleans selected rooms (app only).
* **Spot clean** — cleans a 1.5 m × 1.5 m square around the robot; press and hold the Home button
  for 3 seconds to start.
* **Suction levels** — Eco, Standard, Max. Default is Standard.
* **Carpet boost** — when a carpet is detected the robot automatically switches to Max suction.
  Carpet boost can be disabled in the app.
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Mopping

1. Fill the water tank (300 ml) with clean, cold tap water. Do not use hot water, detergents or
   essential oils — they can damage the pump and void the warranty.
2. Attach the mop pad to the mopping module and click the module onto the back of the robot.
3. The robot detects the module automatically and starts vacuuming and mopping at the same time.
4. Water flow has three levels (Low, Medium, High) and can be changed in the app.
5. When the mopping module is installed, the robot avoids carpets automatically
   (*carpet avoidance*, available since firmware 2.3.0).

Remove the mopping module after each mopping session and empty the water tank.
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Maps, no-go zones and schedules

* The robot creates a map during the first Auto clean. Up to **4 floor maps** can be saved
  (multi-floor support).
* In the app you can split or merge rooms, rename them and add **no-go zones** and **no-mop zones**.
* Up to 10 cleaning schedules can be created in the app.
* **Do Not Disturb** is enabled by default from **22:00 to 08:00**: the robot does not start
  scheduled cleaning and voice prompts are muted. The period can be changed or disabled in the app.
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Maintenance

| Part | Cleaning | Replacement |
|---|---|---|
| Dustbin | empty after every cleaning | — |
| Filter (HEPA) | tap out dust weekly; **do not wash** | every 3 months |
| Main brush | remove hair weekly with the cleaning tool | every 6–12 months |
| Side brush | clean monthly | every 3–6 months |
| Mop pad | wash after every use (hand or machine wash at max 40 °C) | every 3 months |
| Sensors (cliff sensors, LiDAR window, charging contacts) | wipe with a dry soft cloth monthly | — |
| Wheels | remove hair and dirt monthly | — |

The app shows the remaining life of each consumable and reminds you when a replacement is due.
After replacing a part, reset its counter in **App › Device › Maintenance**.
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Battery care

* If the robot is not used for a long period, charge it fully and switch it off; recharge at least
  every 3 months.
* Do not leave the robot with an empty battery for a long time, it may damage the battery.
* The battery may only be replaced by an Orbitra authorized service center.
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Wi-Fi connection problems

* The robot supports **2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only**. If your router uses one network name for 2.4 and 5 GHz
  (band steering), temporarily create a separate 2.4 GHz network or disable 5 GHz during setup.
* Move the robot and dock closer to the router during setup.
* Network names and passwords with special characters such as `&` or `\` may cause pairing to fail.
* Repeat the Wi-Fi reset (Power + Home for 5 seconds).
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Factory reset

A factory reset deletes all maps, schedules and settings. Open the top cover and use a pin to press
and hold the **reset button** (next to the dustbin) for **10 seconds** until the robot announces
"Restoring factory settings". The robot restarts in about one minute.
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual
Section: Safety notes

* Remove cables, socks and small objects from the floor before cleaning.
* Do not use the robot outdoors, on wet floors or near open flames.
* Use only the original charging dock and power adapter.
title: Orbitra RoboVac R7 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: Overview

The Orbitra BrewMate C3 is a fully automatic bean-to-cup coffee machine with a built-in conical
burr grinder and an automatic milk frothing system. It prepares espresso-based drinks and hot
water at the touch of a button.
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: Technical specifications

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Pump pressure | 19 bar |
| Water tank | 1.8 L, removable |
| Bean hopper | 250 g |
| Grounds container | up to 12 coffee pucks |
| Grinder | ceramic conical burr, 12 grind settings (1 = finest, 12 = coarsest) |
| Default grind setting | 6 |
| Power | 1450 W, 220–240 V |
| Heating time | about 40 seconds |
| Cup height | 75–140 mm (adjustable spout) |
| Weight | 8.2 kg |
| Connectivity | none (no Wi-Fi/app); USB-C service port for firmware updates |
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: First use

1. Remove all packaging and rinse the water tank.
2. Determine your water hardness with the supplied test strip and set it in
   **Menu › Settings › Water hardness** (levels 1–4; default is 3).
3. Insert the PureFlow water filter (optional but recommended) — see *Water filter*.
4. Fill the water tank with fresh cold water up to the MAX mark and fill the bean hopper.
5. Switch the machine on with the power button. It heats up and performs an automatic rinse.
6. Prepare and discard the first two cups of coffee — the grinder needs to settle.
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: Control panel and drinks

The touch panel has buttons for the following drinks (default volumes):

| Drink | Default volume |
|---|---|
| Espresso | 40 ml |
| Lungo | 110 ml |
| Americano | 40 ml espresso + 120 ml hot water |
| Cappuccino | 60 ml coffee + 120 ml milk foam |
| Latte macchiato | 40 ml coffee + 200 ml milk |
| Flat white | 80 ml coffee + 80 ml micro-foam (added in firmware 1.3.0) |
| Hot water | 200 ml |

* **Coffee strength** has 5 levels; press the bean icon to cycle through them.
* **Double cup**: press the drink button twice within 2 seconds.
* **Personalising volume**: press and hold a drink button for 3 seconds — the machine starts
  dispensing; press any button to stop when the cup has the desired amount. The new volume is saved.
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: Adjusting the grinder

The grind knob is located inside the bean hopper. **Only turn the knob while the grinder is
running**, otherwise the grinder can be damaged. Turn it one step at a time and judge the result
after 2–3 cups.

* Coffee runs too fast / tastes watery → choose a finer setting (lower number).
* Coffee runs drop by drop / tastes bitter → choose a coarser setting (higher number).
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: Milk system

1. Insert the milk tube into the milk outlet and place the other end into a milk carton or the
   Orbitra milk jug. Use cold milk (about 5 °C) for the best foam.
2. Select Cappuccino, Latte macchiato or Flat white.
3. **After every milk drink**, run the **Milk Clean** program: put a cup under the spout and press
   and hold the milk (cup) button for 3 seconds. The machine rinses the milk system with hot
   water and steam (about 30 seconds).
4. Once a week, disassemble the milk frother and wash its parts in warm water. The parts are also
   dishwasher safe (top rack).
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: Brew group

The brew group can be removed through the service door on the right side.

* Rinse the brew group under lukewarm running water **once a week**. **Do not use detergent** and
  do not put it in the dishwasher.
* Let it dry completely before reinserting it.
* Lubricate the brew group with food-grade Orbitra lubricant every 500 cups or every 2 months.
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: Water filter

* The optional **PureFlow** water filter reduces scale and improves taste.
* Soak a new filter in cold water for 30 seconds and screw it into the bottom of the water tank.
* Activate it in **Menu › Settings › Water filter**. With an active filter the machine reminds you
  to descale much less often.
* Replace the filter every **2 months or after 50 L** of water, whichever comes first.
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: Descaling

Descaling removes limescale from the boiler and pipes. The machine displays the **Descale** icon
(and warning code C6) when descaling is due — typically every **3 months** with water hardness
level 3 and no filter.

1. Remove the PureFlow filter if installed.
2. Empty the drip tray and the grounds container.
3. Pour one bottle (250 ml) of **Orbitra DecalPro** descaling solution into the water tank and add
   water up to the MAX mark.
4. Place a container of at least 1.5 L under the coffee spout and the milk outlet.
5. Select **Menu › Maintenance › Descale** and follow the on-screen instructions.
6. The program takes about **25 minutes**, including two rinsing cycles. Do not interrupt it.

Use only Orbitra DecalPro or another descaler approved for fully automatic coffee machines.
Never use vinegar — it can damage the seals. Damage caused by limescale due to not descaling is not
covered by the warranty.
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: Energy saving

* **Auto-off**: the machine switches off automatically after **30 minutes** of inactivity by
  default. Options: 15, 30, 60 or 120 minutes (**Menu › Settings › Auto-off**).
* An automatic rinse is performed when the machine is switched on and before it switches off.
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: Daily care

* Empty the drip tray and the grounds container when the indicator asks you to, or daily.
* Refill the water tank with fresh water every day.
* Wipe the coffee spout with a damp cloth.
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual
Section: Safety notes

* Do not touch the spout and milk outlet during dispensing — risk of burns.
* Never fill the water tank with milk, sparkling water or hot water.
* Never put ground coffee, instant coffee or caramelised/flavoured beans in the bean hopper —
  it can block the grinder.
title: Orbitra BrewMate C3 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual
Section: Overview

The Orbitra AirPure A5 is an air purifier with a three-stage filtration system and a laser PM2.5
sensor. It removes dust, pollen, pet dander, smoke and odours in rooms up to 45 m².
title: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual
Section: Technical specifications

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Recommended room size | up to 45 m² |
| CADR (particles) | 350 m³/h |
| Filtration | pre-filter + H13 HEPA + activated carbon |
| Sensor | laser PM2.5 sensor |
| Noise level | 22 dB (Sleep mode) to 52 dB (Turbo) |
| Power consumption | 45 W maximum, 1.5 W in standby |
| Wi-Fi | 2.4 GHz |
| Dimensions | 260 × 260 × 520 mm |
| Weight | 5.1 kg |
title: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual
Section: Filtration stages

1. **Pre-filter** — captures hair, lint and large dust. It is washable.
2. **H13 HEPA filter** — captures 99.95% of particles down to 0.3 µm (pollen, fine dust, pet dander).
3. **Activated carbon layer** — absorbs odours, smoke and volatile organic compounds.

The HEPA and carbon layers form one combined **filter cartridge**.
title: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual
Section: Before first use

1. Open the bottom cover by turning it counter-clockwise.
2. Remove the plastic wrapping from the filter cartridge — the purifier will not work properly
   with the wrapping on.
3. Insert the cartridge, close the cover and plug in the purifier.
title: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual
Section: Controls

The touch panel on top has the following buttons: **Power**, **Mode**, **Speed**, **Timer**, **Lock**.

* **Mode** cycles between Auto, Sleep and Turbo.
* **Speed** sets manual fan speed 1, 2 or 3.
* **Timer** sets automatic switch-off after 1, 2, 4 or 8 hours.
* **Child lock**: press and hold **Lock** for **3 seconds** to lock or unlock all buttons.
title: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual
Section: Operating modes

* **Auto** — fan speed is adjusted automatically according to the PM2.5 sensor reading.
* **Sleep** — the quietest mode (22 dB); the display and the light ring switch off.
* **Turbo** — maximum fan speed (52 dB) for fast cleaning, e.g. after cooking.
* **Manual** — fixed speeds 1–3.
title: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual
Section: Air quality indicator

The light ring shows the current PM2.5 concentration:

| Colour | PM2.5 (µg/m³) | Air quality |
|---|---|---|
| Blue | 0–35 | Good |
| Purple | 36–75 | Moderate |
| Red | above 75 | Poor |

The exact value is shown on the display and in the Orbitra Home app.
title: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual
Section: Maintenance

| Part | Action | Interval |
|---|---|---|
| Pre-filter | vacuum or rinse with water, let dry completely | every 2 weeks |
| Filter cartridge (HEPA + carbon) | replace (not washable) | every 6–12 months, or when the filter indicator lights up |
| PM2.5 sensor | clean the sensor lens with a dry cotton swab | every 2 months |
| Housing | wipe with a dry soft cloth | as needed |

The filter life is calculated from operating hours and fan speed. When less than 10% remains, the
filter icon blinks; at 0% the icon is solid and error **F4** is shown.
title: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual
Section: Maintenance › Replacing the filter cartridge

1. Switch off and unplug the purifier.
2. Open the bottom cover, take out the old cartridge and insert a new genuine Orbitra
   A5 filter cartridge.
3. Close the cover and plug in the purifier.
4. **Reset the filter counter**: press and hold the **Timer** button for **5 seconds** until the
   filter icon goes off.
title: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual
Section: App features

* Remote control of modes, speeds and timer.
* PM2.5 history for the last 30 days.
* Filter life percentage and reminders.
* Schedules (e.g. Sleep mode every night from 23:00).
title: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual
Section: Safety notes

* Keep at least 30 cm of free space around the purifier.
* Do not use the purifier in bathrooms or other places with high humidity.
* Never use the purifier without a filter cartridge.
* Do not wash the filter cartridge — water destroys the HEPA and carbon layers.
title: Orbitra AirPure A5 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual
Section: Overview

The Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 is a Wi-Fi smart thermostat for low-voltage (24 V) heating and cooling
systems. It supports schedules, Eco mode, geofencing and remote control from the Orbitra Home app.
title: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual
Section: Technical specifications

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Supply voltage | 24 V AC (C-wire) |
| Compatible systems | 24 V gas/oil furnaces, boilers, central air conditioning, heat pumps (single-stage and two-stage) |
| Setpoint range | 5 °C to 35 °C, in 0.5 °C steps |
| Temperature sensor accuracy | ±0.5 °C |
| Humidity sensor accuracy | ±3% RH |
| Display | 2.4" colour display with rotating ring |
| Wi-Fi | 2.4 GHz (802.11 b/g/n) |
| Battery backup | none |
title: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual
Section: Compatibility

* The T2 works with **24 V low-voltage** HVAC systems.
* It is **not compatible** with high-voltage (120/240 V) line-voltage systems such as electric
  baseboard heaters, and not compatible with millivolt systems (some gas fireplaces).
* A **C-wire (common wire)** is required to power the thermostat. If your system has no C-wire,
  use the **Orbitra Power Adapter PA-1** (sold separately), which is installed at the HVAC unit.
* Use the compatibility checker in the Orbitra Home app before installation.
title: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual
Section: Installation

> Switch off power to the HVAC system at the breaker before removing your old thermostat.

1. Remove the old thermostat and take a photo of the wiring for reference.
2. Label the wires (R, C, W, Y, G, O/B) using the supplied stickers.
3. Mount the T2 base plate on the wall with the supplied screws and level.
4. Connect the wires to the matching terminals.
5. Attach the display to the base plate and switch the power back on.
6. Follow the on-screen setup wizard: language, units, system type and Wi-Fi.
title: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual
Section: Controls

* **Rotate the ring** to change the target temperature.
* **Press the ring** to open the menu and confirm a selection.
* **Factory reset**: Menu › Settings › Reset › Factory reset, or press and hold the ring for
  **15 seconds**.
title: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual
Section: Schedules

* Up to **6 temperature periods per day**, configured for each day of the week.
* Schedules can be created on the device or in the app.
* A manual temperature change is kept until the next scheduled period (temporary hold). A permanent
  hold can be set in the app.
title: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual
Section: Eco mode

Eco mode saves energy when nobody is at home.

* Default Eco temperatures: **17 °C for heating** and **28 °C for cooling**. Both values can be
  changed in the app.
* Eco mode can be activated manually or automatically by geofencing.
title: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual
Section: Geofencing

* Geofencing uses your phone's location to detect when the last household member leaves home and
  switches the thermostat to Eco mode; when someone approaches home it returns to the schedule.
* Default radius is **500 m**. Since firmware 3.1.0 the radius can be adjusted from **200 m to
  2000 m** in the app.
* All household members who should be considered must enable location permission in the app.
title: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual
Section: Other features

* **HVAC filter reminder**: reminds you to replace the filter of your furnace/air conditioner every
  **90 days** (interval adjustable in the app).
* **Energy report**: monthly heating/cooling runtime statistics in the app.
* **Humidity display**: current indoor relative humidity is shown on the display.
title: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual
Section: Wi-Fi

* The thermostat supports **2.4 GHz** networks only.
* To reconnect: Menu › Settings › Wi-Fi › Change network.
* If Wi-Fi is lost the thermostat keeps working with the last saved schedule; error H3 is shown.
title: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual
Section: Safety notes

* Installation must be performed with the HVAC power switched off.
* If you are not sure about the wiring, have the thermostat installed by a qualified technician.
* Do not connect the T2 to 120/240 V wiring — this will destroy the device and is not covered by
  the warranty.
title: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2 — User Manual

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error E01

Error code E01: Wheel stuck (Orbitra RoboVac R7)
Severity: error
Cause: A drive wheel is blocked by hair, a cable or the robot is stuck on an obstacle.
Solution: Lift the robot, remove hair and debris from both drive wheels, check that the wheels turn freely, place the robot on a flat floor and press Power / Clean.
More details in the user manual, section: Maintenance
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error E02

Error code E02: Main brush tangled (Orbitra RoboVac R7)
Severity: error
Cause: Hair, string or a cable is wrapped around the main brush.
Solution: Remove the main brush cover, take out the main brush, cut tangled hair with the cleaning tool blade, clean the brush ends and reinstall.
More details in the user manual, section: Maintenance
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error E03

Error code E03: Side brush stuck (Orbitra RoboVac R7)
Severity: error
Cause: The side brush cannot rotate (usually tangled hair or threads).
Solution: Unscrew the side brush, remove hair from the shaft and brush, reinstall it. Replace the side brush if its bristles are bent.
More details in the user manual, section: Maintenance
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error E04

Error code E04: Cliff sensor dirty or blocked (Orbitra RoboVac R7)
Severity: error
Cause: The cliff sensors under the robot are dirty or the robot is on a very dark/reflective surface.
Solution: Wipe all cliff sensors with a dry soft cloth. If the error appears only on dark carpets, move the robot to another area or add a no-go zone.
More details in the user manual, section: Maintenance
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error E05

Error code E05: Bumper stuck (Orbitra RoboVac R7)
Severity: error
Cause: The front bumper is pressed or jammed by debris.
Solution: Tap the bumper several times gently, remove any debris between the bumper and the body, and make sure it moves freely.
More details in the user manual, section: Safety notes
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error E06

Error code E06: LiDAR sensor blocked (Orbitra RoboVac R7)
Severity: error
Cause: The LiDAR cover on top of the robot is blocked or cannot rotate, or the robot is stuck under low furniture.
Solution: Check that nothing is on top of the LiDAR cover, press the cover gently to make sure it moves, remove dust around it. Move the robot out from under furniture lower than 10 cm. False E06 errors in bright sunlight were fixed in firmware 2.3.0 — update the firmware.
More details in the user manual, section: Maintenance
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error E07

Error code E07: Battery too low to return (Orbitra RoboVac R7)
Severity: warning
Cause: The battery level is too low for the robot to find its way back to the dock.
Solution: Carry the robot to the charging dock manually and let it charge. Make sure the dock is placed according to the installation instructions.
More details in the user manual, section: Installation of the charging dock
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error E08

Error code E08: Dustbin missing (Orbitra RoboVac R7)
Severity: error
Cause: The dustbin is not installed or not fully inserted.
Solution: Insert the dustbin until it clicks into place.
More details in the user manual, section: Maintenance
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error E09

Error code E09: Water tank empty or missing (Orbitra RoboVac R7)
Severity: warning
Cause: The mopping module is attached but the water tank is empty or not detected.
Solution: Refill the water tank with clean cold water, make sure the module clicks into place. If mopping is not needed, remove the module.
More details in the user manual, section: Mopping
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error E10

Error code E10: Charging error (Orbitra RoboVac R7)
Severity: error
Cause: Charging contacts are dirty, the dock has no power, or the battery temperature is outside 0–40 °C.
Solution: Clean the charging contacts on the robot and the dock with a dry cloth, check the dock power cable, move the robot to a room with normal temperature. If the error persists, contact Orbitra support.
More details in the user manual, section: Battery care
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error C1

Error code C1: Water tank empty (Orbitra BrewMate C3)
Severity: warning
Cause: The water tank is empty or not inserted correctly.
Solution: Fill the water tank with fresh cold water and push it in completely until it clicks.
More details in the user manual, section: Daily care
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error C2

Error code C2: Bean hopper empty (Orbitra BrewMate C3)
Severity: warning
Cause: There are no beans in the hopper or the beans are stuck.
Solution: Refill the bean hopper. If beans are present, stir them gently — oily beans can stick together.
More details in the user manual, section: Control panel and drinks
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error C3

Error code C3: Brew group missing (Orbitra BrewMate C3)
Severity: error
Cause: The brew group is not inserted or the service door is open.
Solution: Insert the brew group correctly (the lever must be in the lowest position) and close the service door.
More details in the user manual, section: Brew group
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error C4

Error code C4: Grinder blocked (Orbitra BrewMate C3)
Severity: error
Cause: The grinder is blocked by a foreign object, flavoured/oily beans or ground coffee was put into the hopper.
Solution: Switch off and unplug the machine, empty the bean hopper and vacuum it. Never put ground or caramelised beans in the hopper. If the error persists, contact Orbitra support — do not try to open the grinder yourself.
More details in the user manual, section: Safety notes
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error C5

Error code C5: Drip tray or grounds container full (Orbitra BrewMate C3)
Severity: warning
Cause: The drip tray or the grounds container is full or not inserted.
Solution: Empty and rinse the drip tray and the grounds container and insert them back. Wait at least 5 seconds before reinserting so the counter is reset.
More details in the user manual, section: Daily care
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error C6

Error code C6: Descaling required (Orbitra BrewMate C3)
Severity: warning
Cause: The calculated amount of limescale has reached the limit.
Solution: Run the descaling program with Orbitra DecalPro (about 25 minutes). The machine can still be used for a short time but descaling should be done as soon as possible.
More details in the user manual, section: Descaling
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error C7

Error code C7: Temperature sensor or heater fault (Orbitra BrewMate C3)
Severity: critical
Cause: The heating system is overheated or the temperature sensor is defective.
Solution: Switch off the machine, unplug it and let it cool down for 30 minutes. If C7 appears again, stop using the machine and contact Orbitra support.
More details in the user manual, section: Safety notes
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error C8

Error code C8: Milk system blocked (Orbitra BrewMate C3)
Severity: error
Cause: Dried milk residue is blocking the milk tube or frother.
Solution: Disassemble and wash the milk frother and tube in warm water, then run the Milk Clean program. Run Milk Clean after every milk drink to prevent this.
More details in the user manual, section: Milk system
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error F1

Error code F1: Fan motor fault (Orbitra AirPure A5)
Severity: critical
Cause: The fan motor does not reach the required speed.
Solution: Unplug the purifier for 1 minute and plug it in again. Make sure nothing blocks the air outlet. If F1 persists, contact Orbitra support.
More details in the user manual, section: Safety notes
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error F2

Error code F2: PM2.5 sensor fault (Orbitra AirPure A5)
Severity: error
Cause: The PM2.5 sensor is dirty or defective; Auto mode cannot work.
Solution: Clean the sensor lens with a dry cotton swab (sensor cover on the side of the device). If the error persists, contact Orbitra support. Manual speeds still work.
More details in the user manual, section: Maintenance
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error F3

Error code F3: Filter not installed (Orbitra AirPure A5)
Severity: error
Cause: The filter cartridge is not detected or the bottom cover is not closed properly.
Solution: Insert the filter cartridge (remove its plastic wrapping) and close the bottom cover until it locks.
More details in the user manual, section: Before first use
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error F4

Error code F4: Filter expired (Orbitra AirPure A5)
Severity: warning
Cause: The filter cartridge has reached 0% of its life.
Solution: Replace the filter cartridge with a genuine Orbitra A5 cartridge and reset the filter counter by holding the Timer button for 5 seconds.
More details in the user manual, section: Maintenance
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error H1

Error code H1: No power / low voltage (Orbitra ThermoSmart T2)
Severity: critical
Cause: The C-wire is not connected, loose, or the transformer provides less than 20 V AC.
Solution: Switch off HVAC power, check the C and R wires at the thermostat and at the HVAC unit. If there is no C-wire, install the Orbitra Power Adapter PA-1.
More details in the user manual, section: Compatibility
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error H2

Error code H2: Temperature sensor fault (Orbitra ThermoSmart T2)
Severity: critical
Cause: The internal temperature sensor reports invalid values.
Solution: Restart the thermostat by removing the display from the base plate for 10 seconds. If H2 persists, contact Orbitra support.
More details in the user manual, section: Controls
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error H3

Error code H3: Wi-Fi connection lost (Orbitra ThermoSmart T2)
Severity: warning
Cause: The thermostat cannot connect to the Wi-Fi network.
Solution: Check that your router works and broadcasts a 2.4 GHz network. Reconnect via Menu › Settings › Wi-Fi › Change network. The thermostat keeps following the last saved schedule offline.
More details in the user manual, section: Wi-Fi
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error H4

Error code H4: HVAC system not responding (Orbitra ThermoSmart T2)
Severity: error
Cause: The room temperature has not changed within 30 minutes after heating or cooling was requested.
Solution: Check that the HVAC system is switched on and its breaker is not tripped, check the HVAC filter and the wiring of W (heat) and Y (cool) terminals. Contact your HVAC technician if the system itself is faulty.
More details in the user manual, section: Installation
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Error codes and troubleshooting
Section: Error H5

Error code H5: Wiring error (Orbitra ThermoSmart T2)
Severity: error
Cause: Wires are connected to the wrong terminals (for example both W and Y missing, or O/B configured incorrectly for a heat pump).
Solution: Switch off HVAC power and check the wiring against the photo of your old thermostat. Rerun the setup wizard and select the correct system type.
More details in the user manual, section: Installation
title: Error codes and troubleshooting

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Can the RoboVac R7 connect to a 5 GHz Wi-Fi network?

Q: Can the RoboVac R7 connect to a 5 GHz Wi-Fi network?
A: No. The RoboVac R7 supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only. If your router combines 2.4 and 5 GHz under one name, create a separate 2.4 GHz network or temporarily disable 5 GHz during setup.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Can the RoboVac R7 connect to a 5 GHz Wi-Fi network?

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Can the robot climb over door thresholds?

Q: Can the robot climb over door thresholds?
A: Yes, the RoboVac R7 can climb obstacles up to 20 mm high, such as most door thresholds and rug edges. Higher thresholds should be bridged with a ramp or marked as a no-go zone.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Can the robot climb over door thresholds?

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Will the robot wet my carpets when mopping?

Q: Will the robot wet my carpets when mopping?
A: No. Since firmware 2.3.0 the robot automatically avoids carpets while the mopping module is attached (carpet avoidance). You can also add no-mop zones in the app.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Will the robot wet my carpets when mopping?

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Can I wash the HEPA filter of the robot vacuum?

Q: Can I wash the HEPA filter of the robot vacuum?
A: No. The filter must not be washed — tap out the dust once a week and replace the filter every 3 months.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Can I wash the HEPA filter of the robot vacuum?

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Why did my scheduled cleaning not start at night?

Q: Why did my scheduled cleaning not start at night?
A: Do Not Disturb mode is enabled by default from 22:00 to 08:00. During this period scheduled cleanings do not start and voice prompts are muted. You can change or disable Do Not Disturb in the app.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Why did my scheduled cleaning not start at night?

text:
Product: Orbitra RoboVac R7
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: How many floors can the RoboVac R7 remember?

Q: How many floors can the RoboVac R7 remember?
A: Up to 4 floor maps (since firmware 2.4.0; earlier versions supported 3).
title: Frequently asked questions
section: How many floors can the RoboVac R7 remember?

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: My coffee from the BrewMate C3 tastes watery. What can I do?

Q: My coffee from the BrewMate C3 tastes watery. What can I do?
A: Choose a finer grind setting (lower number) while the grinder is running and increase the coffee strength with the bean icon. Judge the taste after 2–3 cups. Also check that the drink volume is not set too high.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: My coffee from the BrewMate C3 tastes watery. What can I do?

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Can I use vinegar or citric acid to descale the coffee machine?

Q: Can I use vinegar or citric acid to descale the coffee machine?
A: No. Vinegar can damage the seals. Use Orbitra DecalPro or another descaler approved for fully automatic coffee machines.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Can I use vinegar or citric acid to descale the coffee machine?

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Can I put pre-ground coffee in the BrewMate C3?

Q: Can I put pre-ground coffee in the BrewMate C3?
A: No. The BrewMate C3 has no bypass doser for ground coffee. Ground, instant or caramelised/flavoured coffee in the bean hopper can block the grinder (error C4). Use only whole roasted beans.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Can I put pre-ground coffee in the BrewMate C3?

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Can I wash the brew group in the dishwasher?

Q: Can I wash the brew group in the dishwasher?
A: No. Rinse the brew group under lukewarm running water once a week without detergent and let it dry completely. Only the milk frother parts are dishwasher safe.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Can I wash the brew group in the dishwasher?

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: How do I make the machine stay on longer?

Q: How do I make the machine stay on longer?
A: Change the auto-off time in Menu › Settings › Auto-off. Available options are 15, 30 (default), 60 and 120 minutes.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: How do I make the machine stay on longer?

text:
Product: Orbitra BrewMate C3
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Does the BrewMate C3 work with plant-based milk?

Q: Does the BrewMate C3 work with plant-based milk?
A: Yes. Oat, soy and almond drinks labelled 'barista' produce the best foam. Use them cold and run the Milk Clean program after every milk drink, as plant drinks leave residue quickly.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Does the BrewMate C3 work with plant-based milk?

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: How large a room can the AirPure A5 clean?

Q: How large a room can the AirPure A5 clean?
A: The AirPure A5 is recommended for rooms up to 45 m². Its CADR is 350 m³/h.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: How large a room can the AirPure A5 clean?

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Can I wash the HEPA filter of the air purifier?

Q: Can I wash the HEPA filter of the air purifier?
A: Only the pre-filter is washable (every 2 weeks). The HEPA + carbon filter cartridge must never be washed; replace it every 6–12 months.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Can I wash the HEPA filter of the air purifier?

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: The filter indicator is still on after I replaced the filter. Why?

Q: The filter indicator is still on after I replaced the filter. Why?
A: The filter counter must be reset manually: press and hold the Timer button for 5 seconds until the filter icon goes off.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: The filter indicator is still on after I replaced the filter. Why?

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Is the AirPure A5 quiet enough for a bedroom?

Q: Is the AirPure A5 quiet enough for a bedroom?
A: Yes. In Sleep mode the purifier runs at 22 dB and switches off the display and the light ring.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Is the AirPure A5 quiet enough for a bedroom?

text:
Product: Orbitra AirPure A5
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Does the AirPure A5 humidify the air?

Q: Does the AirPure A5 humidify the air?
A: No. The AirPure A5 is an air purifier only; it has no humidifying function and should not be used in bathrooms or very humid places.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Does the AirPure A5 humidify the air?

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Can I use the ThermoSmart T2 with electric baseboard heaters?

Q: Can I use the ThermoSmart T2 with electric baseboard heaters?
A: No. The ThermoSmart T2 works only with 24 V low-voltage systems. It is not compatible with 120/240 V line-voltage systems such as electric baseboard heaters, nor with millivolt systems.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Can I use the ThermoSmart T2 with electric baseboard heaters?

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: My system has no C-wire. Can I still install the thermostat?

Q: My system has no C-wire. Can I still install the thermostat?
A: Yes, with the Orbitra Power Adapter PA-1 (sold separately), which is installed at the HVAC unit and provides power to the thermostat.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: My system has no C-wire. Can I still install the thermostat?

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Does the thermostat keep working if the internet goes down?

Q: Does the thermostat keep working if the internet goes down?
A: Yes. The thermostat continues to follow the last saved schedule and can be controlled on the device. Remote control and geofencing are unavailable until Wi-Fi is restored (error H3).
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Does the thermostat keep working if the internet goes down?

text:
Product: Orbitra ThermoSmart T2
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: How do I change the geofencing radius?

Q: How do I change the geofencing radius?
A: Since firmware 3.1.0 the geofencing radius can be changed in the app between 200 m and 2000 m. The default radius is 500 m.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: How do I change the geofencing radius?

text:
Product: All Orbitra Home products
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: Do Orbitra devices work with voice assistants?

Q: Do Orbitra devices work with voice assistants?
A: Yes. RoboVac R7, AirPure A5 and ThermoSmart T2 can be linked with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant through the Orbitra Home app (Profile › Integrations). The BrewMate C3 has no Wi-Fi and cannot be controlled by voice.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: Do Orbitra devices work with voice assistants?

text:
Product: All Orbitra Home products
Document: Frequently asked questions
Section: How do I update the firmware of my device?

Q: How do I update the firmware of my device?
A: Firmware updates for connected devices are installed over the air through the Orbitra Home app (Device › Settings › Firmware). The BrewMate C3 is updated by an authorized service center or via USB-C with the Orbitra Service Tool.
title: Frequently asked questions
section: How do I update the firmware of my device?

text:
Product: All Orbitra Home products
Document: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy
Section: Warranty period

* All Orbitra Home products (RoboVac R7, BrewMate C3, AirPure A5, ThermoSmart T2) come with a
  **2-year limited warranty** starting from the date of purchase by the first end customer.
* **Exception:** the rechargeable battery of the RoboVac R7 is covered for **1 year**.
* Repaired or replaced products are covered for the remainder of the original warranty period or
  for 90 days, whichever is longer.
title: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy

text:
Product: All Orbitra Home products
Document: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy
Section: What is covered

Defects in materials and workmanship under normal household use in accordance with the user
manual. Orbitra will, at its discretion, repair the product, replace it with a new or refurbished
product of equal value, or refund the purchase price.
title: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy

text:
Product: All Orbitra Home products
Document: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy
Section: What is not covered

* **Consumables and wear parts**: filters (robot vacuum filter, AirPure filter cartridge, PureFlow
  water filter), brushes, mop pads, descaling solution, lubricant.
* Damage caused by not following the maintenance instructions, in particular **limescale damage**
  in the BrewMate C3 when descaling was not performed, or use of vinegar as a descaler.
* Damage caused by using hot water, detergents or oils in the RoboVac R7 water tank.
* Connection of the ThermoSmart T2 to 120/240 V wiring.
* Physical damage, liquid damage (except intended use), fire, power surges.
* Repairs or modifications made by anyone other than an Orbitra authorized service center.
* Commercial use (offices, cafés, hotels) — the products are intended for household use only.
* Cosmetic wear such as scratches.
title: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy

text:
Product: All Orbitra Home products
Document: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy
Section: Proof of purchase

A valid proof of purchase (receipt or invoice showing the date, the seller and the product model)
is required for every warranty claim. Registering the product in the Orbitra Home app stores the
purchase date but does not replace the receipt.
title: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy

text:
Product: All Orbitra Home products
Document: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy
Section: Orbitra Care+ extended warranty

* **Orbitra Care+** extends the warranty by **2 additional years** (total 4 years).
* It can be purchased in the Orbitra Home app or online **within 60 days** of the product purchase.
* Care+ also covers the RoboVac R7 battery for the full extended period.
* Care+ does not cover consumables or accidental damage.
title: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy

text:
Product: All Orbitra Home products
Document: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy
Section: How to make a warranty claim

1. Open a support ticket in the Orbitra Home app (**Profile › Support › New ticket**) or write to
   support@orbitra.example. Include the serial number, the problem description, the error code
   (if any) and the proof of purchase.
2. Support will try to solve the problem remotely first.
3. If a repair is needed, you receive a free shipping label. Pack the product in its original
   packaging or equivalent protective packaging.
4. Typical repair turnaround is **7–10 business days** after the product arrives at the service
   center.
title: Orbitra Home — Limited Warranty Policy
section: How to make a warranty claim

text:
Product: All Orbitra Home products
Document: Orbitra Home — Returns and Customer Support
Section: Right of return

* Products bought directly from the Orbitra online store can be returned within **30 days** of
  delivery without giving a reason.
* The product must be complete, undamaged and returned with all accessories. Original packaging is
  preferred.
* For hygiene reasons, a BrewMate C3 that has already been used to make coffee can only be returned
  under the warranty policy (if defective), not under the 30-day right of return.
* Products bought from other retailers must be returned to that retailer according to its policy.
title: Orbitra Home — Returns and Customer Support

text:
Product: All Orbitra Home products
Document: Orbitra Home — Returns and Customer Support
Section: Refunds

* Refunds are issued to the original payment method within **14 days** after the returned product
  is received and inspected.
* Return shipping is free for defective products. For returns without a defect, the return shipping
  cost of 9.90 EUR is deducted from the refund.
title: Orbitra Home — Returns and Customer Support

text:
Product: All Orbitra Home products
Document: Orbitra Home — Returns and Customer Support
Section: Contacting support

| Channel | Availability |
|---|---|
| Orbitra Home app (Profile › Support) | 24/7 ticket submission |
| E-mail: support@orbitra.example | answer within 1 business day |
| Phone hotline | Monday–Friday, 9:00–18:00 CET |
